## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 한국이 세계 수출 4위권 진입을 눈앞에 두고 있으나, 양호한 수출 실적에도 불구하고 고환율이 좀처럼 해소되지 않는 미스터리한 상황이 지속되고 있다. 외환 분야에서는 미-이란 핵합의 기대감으로 국제유가가 급락하고 미국 증시 선물이 상승하는 등 지정학적 긴장 완화 신호가 감지되며, 이것이 달러 약세와 원화 강세로 이어지는 환율 하락 경로가 열릴 수 있다는 분석도 나온다. 부동산 시장에서는 서울 아파트 상승폭이 둔화되고 선도 아파트 가격이 3개월 연속 하락세를 보이는 가운데, 정부가 주택 공급 부족 해소책으로 수도권 비아파트 4만 1천 호 공급 및 지연 주택 10만 호 조기 착공 계획을 발표하며 시장 안정화에 나섰다. 전반적으로 수출·금융·부동산 전 분야에서 과열이 진정되고 안정을 모색하는 흐름이 동시에 나타나는 하루였다.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea's First Monetary Policy Meeting Under New Governor on May 28
key_headlines.summary: New Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song will hold the first monetary policy meeting on May 28, with expectations of a hawkish hold amid strong Q1 GDP growth of 1.7% and rising inflation concerns.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing exceptional momentum driven by semiconductor sector strength, with Q1 real GDP growth reaching 1.7% quarter-on-quarter. The country is positioned to achieve record export figures exceeding $924 billion and record trade surplus of $220 billion this year, thanks to surging semiconductor demand from global AI competition among tech giants. Nominal growth is expected to reach an exceptional 10%, potentially lifting per capita national income to $40,000. However, persistent high exchange rates remain paradoxical given Korea's strong economic performance, creating market uncertainty despite stellar export figures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Industrial Research Institute has raised Korea's 2026 real GDP growth forecast from 1.9% to 2.5%, citing robust semiconductor exports and favorable external conditions. Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song will conduct the first monetary policy committee meeting on May 28, with markets expecting a rate hold coupled with hawkish messaging given stronger-than-expected Q1 growth and elevated April inflation at 2.6% year-on-year. The upward revision of both growth and inflation projections may prompt the central bank to signal rate hike possibilities later in the year, providing policy support for economic momentum.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI has achieved a historic milestone by breaking through 8,000 on a closing basis for the first time, surging 2.55% to 8,047.51, representing a rapid 1,000-point gain in just 20 days since crossing 7,000. The rally has been driven by semiconductor strength and optimism regarding geopolitical de-escalation, with leverage ETFs playing a significant role in market liquidity. However, despite equity market surge, the won has weakened against the dollar, bonds and won-denominated assets have fallen sharply, and fear indices have spiked, reflecting investor anxiety over persistent inflation and exchange rate instability despite record stock valuations.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector continues to power Korea's economic growth, with Chinese battery competitors intensifying technological competition by adopting strategies similar to Korea's semiconductor innovation approach. Hyundai Motor has embarked on manufacturing innovation targeting 20% cost reduction to counter Chinese competition. Samsung Display's OLED technology has been selected for Ferrari's debut electric vehicle, the Lusso, while domestic researchers have developed advanced wireless charging technology for implantable medical devices to reduce battery replacement surgery burdens.
sections.Real Estate: The government is expanding non-apartment housing supply with plans to provide 41,000 non-apartment units in the Seoul metropolitan area and accelerate construction of 100,000 delayed units to address persistent housing shortages. Rising apartment prices in Seoul and Gyeonggi provinces have prompted President Lee to directly order countermeasures, emphasizing the importance of policy credibility amid renewed price increases following the expiration of capital gains tax surcharges for multi-property owners. Long-term lease disputes have emerged as lease terms mature, with residents demanding lease renewal guarantees and sales conversion options that municipalities struggle to accommodate.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve faces internal debate over monetary policy with new Chair Kevin Walsh beginning his tenure amid inflation concerns, as inflation has posted its largest increase since 2023 and multiple policymakers oppose rate cut signals. US companies continue pursuing clean energy procurement despite political headwinds, with renewable energy PPA prices rising sharply due to supply constraints, grid limitations, and regulatory delays. South Korea and the EU have strengthened economic security cooperation by establishing a new trade and economic security committee focused on supply chain resilience and critical mineral procurement.
sections.AI & Economy: NHN Cloud has launched 'FactoryX', an AI full-stack brand providing comprehensive support from GPU infrastructure to AI agent execution, planning to expand AI business revenue share from 14% last year to 38% this year and over 50% next year. Korea Water Resources Corporation has partnered with OpenAI to develop AI-based water management technology for global climate disaster response, targeting a $96 trillion climate-tech market. However, AI operating costs have emerged as a critical concern, with major tech companies struggling to manage ballooning computing expenses, raising questions about AI cost-effectiveness versus human labor alternatives.
sections.Others: Following the escalating Iran-US military conflict, peace negotiations have reached a critical stage with the US presenting substantive concessions to resolve nuclear material handling issues, with Qatar hosting final negotiations. The US-led government has declared heightened security measures against the Mythos AI model developed by Anthropic, which despite being designed as a white-hat security tool, poses risks of being weaponized as a super-strong AI hacker threatening existing systems. Venture capital industry leaders have urged Seoul's next mayor to prioritize innovation-driven company development, highlighting Seoul's 37% venture investment company ratio and 2025 venture ecosystem contributing 3.26 trillion won in investment and 240,000 jobs.
